
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhulu/p/19243749" title="发布于 2025-11-21 17:48">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">腾讯云服务器手动安装 Docker 记录：好记性不如烂笔头</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space" style="margin-left: 30px">
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">双十一又到了，每年这个时候都是入手便宜云服务器的好时机。我的策略是每年换一家云服务商，这样总能以新用户身份享受最优惠的价格，嘿嘿。今年对比下来，发现企鹅家的新用户套餐真香，4 核 4G 配置一年只需 38 元，刚好我还是他家的新用户，果断准备开抢。</div>
<div class="container-Uxvbjy md-box-line-break wrapper-GYqxgQ undefined">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">前面几天都是人肉去抢，结果往往是还没点进去就显示已抢光。没办法，只能上强度了，去网上找了个 JS 脚本自己再改了改。果然，科技改变效率，用脚本抢了 2 次就成功拿下。</div>
<div class="container-Uxvbjy md-box-line-break wrapper-GYqxgQ undefined">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">抢到服务器后，本来想直接部署自己的小系统，结果发现通过脚本抢的这个服务器版本不带 Docker。想着那就自己动手安装吧，结果发现之前安装 Docker 的步骤已经忘得一干二净（虽然之前确实装过）。只好又去网上搜罗一圈步骤，磕磕绊绊折腾半天总算搞定。</div>
<div class="container-Uxvbjy md-box-line-break wrapper-GYqxgQ undefined">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">后面转念一想，为啥不把这次的安装过程详细记录下来呢？一来能加深记忆，二来下次再忘了，直接看自己的文章多方便。所以就有了这篇笔记，纯纯为了给自己留档，也希望能帮到有同样需求的朋友～&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space" style="margin-left: 30px">
<h1 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">1、连接服务器</h1>
<p>由我的工作电脑是Windows ，刚好电脑上有PuTTY，我就用它连接云服务器了。</p>
<p>连上去之后，先看看系统信息，做到心中有数。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">// 查看系统发行版
cat /etc/os-releases　</pre>
</div>
<p>输出内容：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">NAME="OpenCloudOS"
VERSION="9.4"
ID="opencloudos"
ID_LIKE="opencloudos"
VERSION_ID="9.4"
PLATFORM_ID="platform:oc9"
PRETTY_NAME="OpenCloudOS 9.4"
ANSI_COLOR="0;31"
CPE_NAME="cpe:/o:opencloudos:opencloudos:9"
HOME_URL="https://www.opencloudos.org/"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://bugs.opencloudos.tech/"</pre>
</div>
<p>去网上查了一下：OpenCloudOS 是一个开源的、企业级的 Linux 操作系统发行版，由中国国内多家头部科技企业（包括腾讯、阿里、华为、中兴、京东、中科方德等）共同发起并维护，目标是打造一个稳定、高性能、安全、自主可控的服务器操作系统生态。</p>
<p><span data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i51.39367551F4c7Vz">OpenCloudOS 9（对标 RHEL 9 / CentOS Stream 9），完全兼容&nbsp;EL9（Enterprise Linux 9）&nbsp;生态</span></p>
<ul data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i49.39367551F4c7Vz">
<li data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i53.39367551F4c7Vz">使用&nbsp;<code>dnf</code>/<code>yum</code>&nbsp;包管理</li>
<li>支持 RPM 软件包</li>
<li>系统服务由&nbsp;<code>systemd</code>&nbsp;管理</li>
</ul>
<p>再去看看 CPU、内存等信息是否跟购买时一致。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;"># 查看 CPU 型号、核心数、线程数
lscpu

# 查看内存总量、使用情况（人类可读）
free -h

# 查看详细内存信息
cat /proc/meminfo

# 查看磁盘分区和挂载情况
df -h

# 查看所有块设备（硬盘、分区、LVM 等）
lsblk
</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;各个命令输出的具体信息有点多，就不全部贴出来了，对了一下，和购买时宣传的配置是一致的。</p>
<h1 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">2、安装 Docker</h1>
<h3>2.1&nbsp;升级所有包（可选）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">注意​ 
yum -y update：升级所有包同时也升级软件和系统内核；​ 
yum -y upgrade：只升级所有包，不升级软件和系统内核
</pre>
</div>
<h3><span style="font-size: 1em">2.2 卸载旧版本Docker（</span>如有<span style="font-size: 1em">）</span></h3>
<p>我这是新服务器，肯定没安装过。但为了教程的完整性，如果你之前安装过，可以执行下面命令进行卸载。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum remove docker  docker-common docker-selinux docker-engine
</pre>
</div>
<h3>2.3 安装Docker依赖包</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum install -y yum-utils device-mapper-persistent-data lvm2
</pre>
</div>
<p>我执行的时候，系统提示这些包已经存在了，所以这一步可能不是必须的，但执行一下也无妨。</p>
<h3>2.4&nbsp;<strong>设置 yum 源</strong></h3>
既然是企鹅云我想着就用企鹅的Docker仓库应该是最快。我也一并提供了 Docker 官方和阿里云的仓库地址。</div>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space" style="margin-left: 30px">
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum-config-manager --add-repo https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo （企鹅家仓库）

yum-config-manager --add-repo http://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo（中央仓库）

yum-config-manager --add-repo http://mirrors.aliyun.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo（阿里仓库）</pre>
</div>
<p>我首先执行的是第一条腾讯仓库的命令。执行后，我想查看一下是否设置成功，并看看有哪些 Docker 版本可以安装。</p>
<p>查看repo是否添加成功</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum repolist all</pre>
</div>
<p>查看Docker版本</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum list docker-ce --showduplicates | sort -r</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p><span style="color: rgba(24, 24, 24, 1); font-family: &quot;Pingfang SC&quot;, &quot;helvetica neuepingfang SC&quot;, &quot;helvetica neue&quot;, arial, &quot;hiragino sans gb&quot;, &quot;microsoft yahei ui&quot;, &quot;microsoft yahei&quot;, simsun, sans-serif; white-space: pre">　　就在这里，我遇到了一个小坑，执行命令后报错了：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">Errors during downloading metadata for repository 'docker-ce-stable':
  - Curl error (35): SSL connect error for https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/9/x86_64/stable/repodata/15785a63d2ef1d07302d019d57565000357f16c1421237558eba5342e218f36d-updateinfo.xml.zst [Recv failure: Connection reset by peer]
  - Curl error (35): SSL connect error for https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/9/x86_64/stable/repodata/9fe12bed8f871e1595bb2bb10c5fb7c4d283e61b0828109263f647ea99c7e878-primary.xml.zst [Recv failure: Connection reset by peer]
Error: Failed to download metadata for repo 'docker-ce-stable': Yum repo downloading error: Downloading error(s): repodata/9fe12bed8f871e1595bb2bb10c5fb7c4d283e61b0828109263f647ea99c7e878-primary.xml.zst - Cannot download, <br>all mirrors were already tried without success; repodata/15785a63d2ef1d07302d019d57565000357f16c1421237558eba5342e218f36d-updateinfo.xml.zst - Cannot download, all mirrors were already tried without success
</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">错误信息显示，系统试图从&nbsp;<code>download.docker.com</code>&nbsp;下载元数据，而不是企鹅的镜像地址，并且&nbsp;<code>centos/9</code>&nbsp;的路径找不到。</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">我排查后发现，虽然我添加的是企鹅云的仓库地址&nbsp;<code>https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo</code>，但这个文件的内容指向的 baseurl 仍然是&nbsp;<code>https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/$releasever/$basearch/stable</code>。这就导致了我的服务器（OpenCloudOS 9，<code>$releasever</code>&nbsp;为 9）去访问官方的 CentOS 9 仓库，而官方可能已经不维护或者我的网络访问不到。相比之下，阿里云的仓库文件返回的内容就是其自己的仓库地址。</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo 返回的内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">[docker-ce-stable]
name=Docker CE Stable - $basearch
baseurl=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/$releasever/$basearch/stable
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/gpg

[docker-ce-stable-source]
name=Docker CE Stable - Sources
baseurl=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/$releasever/source/stable
enabled=0
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/gpg

[docker-ce-test]
name=Docker CE Test - $basearch
baseurl=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/$releasever/$basearch/test
enabled=0
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/gpg

[docker-ce-test-source]
name=Docker CE Test - Sources
baseurl=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/$releasever/source/test
enabled=0
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/gpg</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">没办法我只能编辑一下，通过 VI 编辑一下&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;"># 1. 编辑文件
sudo vi /etc/yum.repos.d/docker-ce.repo

# 2. 按 i 进入插入模式
# 3. 全选删除（可选）：
#    - 按 Esc → 输入 :%d → 回车（删除全部内容）
# 4. 粘贴新配置（如前面提供的腾讯云+centos8内容）
# 5. 按 Esc 退出插入模式
# 6. 输入 :wq 并回车，保存退出
# 7. 输入 :q! 不保存强制退出
# 8. 输入 :w 仅保存不退出
# 9. 输入 :q 退出（无修改时）
</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">&nbsp;编辑后的内容为：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">[docker-ce-stable]
name=Docker CE Stable - $basearch
baseurl=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/$releasever/$basearch/stable
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/gpg

[docker-ce-stable-source]
name=Docker CE Stable - Sources
baseurl=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/$releasever/source/stable
enabled=0
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/gpg

[docker-ce-test]
name=Docker CE Test - $basearch
baseurl=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/$releasever/$basearch/test
enabled=0
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/gpg

[docker-ce-test-source]
name=Docker CE Test - Sources
baseurl=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/$releasever/source/test
enabled=0
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/gpg</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">修改后，再次执行&nbsp;<code>yum list docker-ce --showduplicates | sort -r</code>&nbsp;命令，就可以正常显示 Docker 的版本列表了</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/494241/202511/494241-20251121170701414-1039235517.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 style="margin-left: 30px">&nbsp;2.5 选择一个版本并安装：<code>yum install docker-ce-版本号</code>&nbsp;</h3>
<p style="margin-left: 30px"><span style="color: rgba(24, 24, 24, 1); font-family: &quot;Pingfang SC&quot;, &quot;helvetica neuepingfang SC&quot;, &quot;helvetica neue&quot;, arial, &quot;hiragino sans gb&quot;, &quot;microsoft yahei ui&quot;, &quot;microsoft yahei&quot;, simsun, sans-serif; white-space: pre">这里我就选择了最新的一个版本</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">sudo yum -y install docker-ce-3:29.0.2-1.el9
</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">（请根据你查看到的实际版本号进行替换）</p>
<h3 style="margin-left: 30px">2.6 启动 Docker 并设置开机自启</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">systemctl start docker
systemctl enable docker</pre>
</div>
<h3 style="margin-left: 30px">2.7 查看 Docker 版本，验证安装</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">docker version
</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">如果能成功显示 Client 和 Server 的版本信息，就代表 Docker 已经安装并启动成功了。&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">我的输出如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">[root@VM-0-9-opencloudos ~]# docker version
Client: Docker Engine - Community
 Version:           29.0.2
 API version:       1.52
 Go version:        go1.25.4
 Git commit:        8108357
 Built:             Mon Nov 17 12:36:49 2025
 OS/Arch:           linux/amd64
 Context:           default

Server: Docker Engine - Community
 Engine:
  Version:          29.0.2
  API version:      1.52 (minimum version 1.44)
  Go version:       go1.25.4
  Git commit:       e9ff10b
  Built:            Mon Nov 17 12:33:39 2025
  OS/Arch:          linux/amd64
  Experimental:     false
 containerd:
  Version:          v2.1.5
  GitCommit:        fcd43222d6b07379a4be9786bda52438f0dd16a1
 runc:
  Version:          1.3.3
  GitCommit:        v1.3.3-0-gd842d771
 docker-init:
  Version:          0.19.0
  GitCommit:        de40ad0
</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">到此，腾讯云上的Docker就安装完成了！</p>
<h1 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br" style="margin-left: 30px">3、抢服务器的 JS 脚本（仅供学习参考）</h1>
<p class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br" style="margin-left: 30px">最后，附上我之前用来抢服务器的 JS 脚本，有需要的同学可以自取。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter" style="margin-left: 30px">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">let interval = setInterval(() =&gt; {
    const ele = document
        .getElementsByClassName(
            "uno3-buy-card uno3-buy-card-normal uno3-buy-card-recom uno3-buy-card-seckill"
        )[0]
        .getElementsByClassName("uno3-buy-card__btn")[0];
    console.log(ele.innerText);
    // 配置选择弹层的底部
    const button1 = document.getElementsByClassName("uno3-dialog-footer");
    if (button1 &amp;&amp; button1.length &gt; 0) {
        // 高频点击定时器（每30ms点击一次）
        setInterval(() =&gt; {
            console.log("抢！！！");
            document
                .getElementsByClassName("uno3-dialog-footer-mobile")[0]
                .getElementsByClassName("uno3-button uno3-button--primary")[0]
                .click();
        }, 30);
        // 清除主定时器（停止主循环）
        clearInterval(interval);
        return;
    }
    if (ele.innerText != "添加提醒" &amp;&amp; ele.innerText != "取消提醒") {
        ele.click();
    }
}, 50);
</pre>
</div>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">使用方法：</p>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li style="list-style-type: none"><ol>
<li>在抢购页面，按&nbsp;<code>F12</code>&nbsp;打开开发者工具（要先登录并实名认证）。</li>
<li>切换到&nbsp;<code>Console</code>&nbsp;(控制台) 标签页。</li>
<li>将上述代码复制粘贴到控制台中，回车执行。</li>
<li>脚本会自动检测并点击购买按钮。&nbsp;</li>
</ol></li>
</ol>

</ul>
</li>
</ul>
